# 1 Clement Chapter 22 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalence)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 22 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_022_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 22

**22:1** All of this is confirmed by our faith in Christ. For it is Christ himself, speaking through the Holy Spirit, who says: "Come, children — listen to me. I will teach you what it means to fear the Lord."

**22:2** "Do you want to really live? Do you want to enjoy good days?

**22:3** Then guard what you say — stop speaking evil, stop letting your mouth spread lies.

**22:4** Reject evil and do good. Pursue peace — go after it.

**22:5** The Lord watches over those who do right, and he listens when they call out to him.

**22:6** But the Lord sets his face against evildoers — he will erase every trace of them from the earth." [Ps 34:11-16]

**22:7** And again: "The righteous person cried out, and the Lord heard and rescued them from all their troubles." [Ps 34:17]

**22:8** "The righteous face many troubles — but the Lord delivers them from every one." [Ps 34:19]

**22:9** "The wicked have plenty of troubles too — but those who trust in the Lord are wrapped in mercy." [Ps 32:10]

---

*PNEUMA renders for pastoral directness. Christ speaks through the Psalm as teacher.*
